page_title: LYO 3-0 TOU | Lyon v Toulouse 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Some great play by Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
88' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
87' Diego Moreira (Lyon) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
87' Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but Anthony Lopes punches the ball away.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dejan Lovren walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mamadou Sarr (Lyon).
83' Substitution. Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) has come on for Aron Donnum.
83' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Frank Magri will be replaced by Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse).
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Stijn Spierings will be replaced by Cristian Casseres (Toulouse).
80' 3 - 0 After a goalmouth scramble the ball rebounds out to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) who buries it from close range straight into the bottom right corner.
80' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Tino Kadewere (Lyon) inside the box.
80' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
79' The game has begun to heat up. Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
76' Logan Costa (Toulouse) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Anthony Lopes makes a comfortable save.
75' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
74' Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul after Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) hacks down one of his opponents. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Toulouse.
71' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
71' An attempted cross from Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) is cleared.
70' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Vincent Sierro is replaced by Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse).
70' Substitution. Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) on for Gabriel Suazo.
69' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Lyon are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
68' Pierre Gaillouste shows a yellow card to Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) for his blatant foul.
67' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Corentin Tolisso and he is replaced by Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon).
67' That will be all from Ernest Nuamah who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Tino Kadewere (Lyon).
66' What a big chance! Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.

64' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by the excellent Guillaume Restes.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aron Donnum (Toulouse) was quite harsh and Pierre Gaillouste didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
61' Frank Magri (Toulouse) drills a first-timer from the edge of the box that flies towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper stops the shot from going into his goal net with a quick save.
59' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Diego Moreira (Lyon) replaces Rayan Cherki.
59' The substitution is prepared. Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Clinton Mata.
58' The flag is raised and Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is offside again, not for the first time today.
57' Good chance! Aron Donnum (Toulouse) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
56' Chance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Ernest Nuamah, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
55' Logan Costa (Toulouse) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
54' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
53' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle and it's Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Toulouse have been awarded a free kick.
50' A pass from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is intercepted by Guillaume Restes and the move breaks down.

47' Frank Magri (Toulouse) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
45+1' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Anthony Lopes who easily stops the effort.
45+1' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Anthony Lopes (Lyon) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Toulouse!
42' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
41' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pierre Gaillouste had an easy-decision to make.
41' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
40' Foul! Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Lyon.
38' Clinton Mata (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Pierre Gaillouste stops the game and makes a call. Toulouse win a free kick.
37' Anthony Lopes displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Frank Magri (Toulouse) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

35' The game is interrupted. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Lyon have a free kick.
34' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) tackles a bit over-zealously and Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul. Toulouse will take a free kick near the side line.
32' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
29' 2 - 0 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
29' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) fails to score from inside the six-yard box as his rebound hits the right-hand post.
28' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon will take a free kick.
25' 1 - 0 GOAL - 1:0! The corner comes over and Jake O'Brien flicks on with his head to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
25' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner.

25' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lyon.
25' The yellow card goes to Frank Magri (Toulouse).
24' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' The game is interrupted as Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is flagged offside.

19' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
19' Lyon have a corner.

18' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Guillaume Restes guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
15' Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle after Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Toulouse have a free kick from a promising distance.
13' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
11' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.

7' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
6' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is penalised for holding. Pierre Gaillouste signals a set piece. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lyon.
4' A cross from Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
3' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
2' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Pierre Gaillouste stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick to Toulouse.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste is introduced as the referee for today's match.
